scope: Liyue Cor Lapis forge, purpose-built gear, enemy tiers, affixes, line-up roles

checks.name: Liyue specialties exist with official names and appear in the right mining and gathering spots
mining a Cor Lapis spot can yield Cor Lapis
the Liyue equipment shop crafts every purpose-built item, consuming materials, mora and time
crafted gear carries its purpose as traits, enhances like other forge gear and is not simply stronger than Mond gear
old Mond gear keeps a niche: the ember charm stacks with Liyue heat armour against fire fields
enemy tiers only touch field battles in Mond and Liyue, and never consume the shared RNG
risk and out-levelling raise the chance of promotions; danger bodies appear only in risky areas
affixes are mechanics with counters: armour, ward, sniper, commander, regeneration, mending, hazard trails, vanguard
a shield in front covers the shooters behind it against single attacks, not against area attacks
promoted enemies drop extra materials on victory; XP and the bounded field Mora stay the same; saves validate
battle and forge screens show tiers, line-up hints, hazards and wiring order
